facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT's Department of Research, Science, Technology and Innovation held a two-day stakeholder validation session on the draft review of the National STI Policy and the combined 4IR and 5IR Strategy (covering AI, automation and data governance), at which the director said the draft was brought back to stakeholders to refine, and ESEPARC, an economic policy research centre, presented.
facts.system: National STI Policy and combined 4IR and 5IR Strategy review
